title: jbs co owner lobbied trump lower beef import tariffs wsj reports 2026 09 01
text:
Aug 31 (Reuters) - Brazilian billionaire Joesley Batista, one of ​the owners of meatpacker ‌JBS (Z98.F)
, opens new tab
, met U.S. President Donald Trump on August 20 ​to discuss how ​additional beef supply from ⁠Brazil could help ​tame U.S. beef prices ​if Trump dropped a 26% import tax, the Wall ​Street Journal reported ​on Monday, citing people familiar with ‌the ⁠matter.
A day later, Trump said he will temporarily ease beef tariffs ​to help ​lower ⁠prices and said ground beef ​imports would sell ​25% ⁠below current prices.
Reuters could not immediately verify ⁠the ​report.
